case.title: Double-clicking Place order creates two orders and charges twice
case.summary: Race condition in OrderService.placeOrder() allowed two concurrent requests for the same cart to both pass the hasOrderFor() guard before either payment resolved, creating duplicate orders and charges. Fixed by adding a `private readonly pending = new Set()` guard: checked synchronously before the payment await, populated before the await, and cleared in a finally block. The repro test (tests/bugproof/bug-07-double-order.test.ts) fires two concurrent placeOrder calls with a 10ms payment delay to force the race window, asserting exactly 1 order and 1 charge. Test suite went from 117 pass / 1 fail → 118 pass / 0 fail. Bisect was attempted but the culprit commit could not be identified due to module resolution failures in the git worktree.

plainSummary.text: When a customer clicked the "Place order" button twice very quickly, a second identical order was created, causing the customer to be charged twice. This happened because the order service did not properly prevent two ordering attempts from overlapping and racing for the same open cart. The code was changed to track ordering attempts in progress and block new attempts until the first one finishes, ensuring only one order is created and charged per cart even when two ordering attempts happen at the same time.

data.summary: Race condition in OrderService.placeOrder(): hasOrderFor() checks committed orders only. Two concurrent requests both pass the guard before either payment completes. Both proceed to charge and push orders, creating duplicates. Fix: add a pending Set guard before the async payment call.

data.expected: One order and one payment per cart. A second concurrent request for the same cart should be rejected while the first is in-flight.
data.actual: Two orders (ORD-0001, ORD-0002) and two charges created for the same cart when Place Order is double-clicked within the ~1-second payment window.
data.source: intake/bug-07-issue.md — issue with log excerpt showing duplicate POST /api/orders at req_a1 and req_a2, and reconciliation warning about duplicate charge

data.notes: Race window: hasOrderFor() checks only committed orders in this.orders. Two concurrent callers both pass the guard before either payment await resolves. Both push to this.orders after the await. No in-flight/pending-Set guard exists. UI button also lacks disable-during-submit.

reasons: Test correctly encodes the race condition: FakePaymentGateway(10) forces both concurrent calls past the synchronous guard before either resolves; assertions on orders.length, charges.length, and fulfilled.length all map to the three symptoms documented in the bug report.

Fix is minimal and correct: the pending Set is checked and populated synchronously before the first await, and cleaned up in a finally block; no concurrent JS coroutine can interleave inside the synchronous segment (lines 51-54), so the guard is race-proof within Node.js single-threaded execution.
All 118 tests pass; no existing behaviour is altered — hasOrderFor() and DuplicateOrderError semantics are unchanged, and the new pending check is purely additive.
